name: Smothered Chicken Thighs
subtitle: Oven-baked chicken with bacon, mushrooms, and cream
description: Bone-in chicken thighs are seasoned, browned with bacon, baked in broth, and finished with a creamy mushroom sauce.

ingredients.preparation: white and green parts separated and sliced

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Mix the paprika with salt and pepper, and season the chicken thighs.
Cook the bacon in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes, until rendered and crisp. Transfer the bacon to a plate and drain excess fat from the skillet.
Pour the chicken broth into the skillet and bring it to a simmer for 4 minutes, scraping up browned bits. Return the bacon to the skillet, reserving the green onion tops.
Nestle the chicken thighs skin-side up in the skillet and bake until the thickest part reaches 165°F.
Transfer the chicken to a serving plate. Keep the skillet juices and return the skillet to the stovetop.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 4 minutes, until softened.
Stir in the heavy whipping cream and simmer until the sauce is lightly thickened. Season with salt and pepper.
Stir in the sliced green onion whites and spoon the sauce over the chicken. Scatter the green onion tops over the servings.
